compact.$description: Floors of compact mode (a phone: window short side < 500 density-independent px, STUDENT_GAME_UX §2; DESIGN_SYSTEM §5.2, F125). Applied over the grade-band density: every value is max(band, compact), never smaller than the band.

small.$description: Smallest font size in compact mode, every band (≥ 12 CSS px on a 740×360 phone at the compact canvas height).

min_height.$description: Minimum button height in compact mode, every band (≥ 40 CSS px touch target on a 740×360 phone; g1_3 keeps its 64).
